metadata.creator: Unique & Unusual Shortwave Broadcasts
metadata.description:
Sometimes when I tune around the shortwave spectrum I'll come across unusual sounds or broadcasts that either I can't identify or find elusive in nature.  These can range from being amusing/entertaining to just plain weird and have their own place here - Aeronautical, Clandestine, Digital/Data, Fisherman/Outbanders/Pescadores, Meteorological, Military, UNID_pirate & Unknown.

Most of these broadcasts were recorded using a Ten Tec RX-340 receiver & DX Engineering's 4 Sq. system using Audacity software through an M-Audio Delta 66 interface via the Ten Tec's DC-Coupled audio tap for SSB or Sherwood Engineering's SE-3 for AM.  Also, the majority of these stations were recorded from North East Florida.  Some of these I do not have exact dates/times/frequencies, but will add the info later if found.

Enjoy : )

Sealord
